given: a Staff Member holding configuration.manage with reach to the Property
then: the name changes, the rail and the Property switcher show it on the next read

given: any Staff Member who may configure
when: they save a name that is empty, one character, only spaces, or longer than 120 characters
then: refused by the existing check constraint (two to 120 trimmed characters); the form says what a name must be and keeps what they typed

given: a Property no Folio has been opened in
when: they save EUR in place of TRY
then: the currency changes and the next Folio opened copies EUR

given: a Property with at least one Folio open or closed
then: refused by a trigger that counts Folios as a security definer, so a Staff Member who cannot read Folios is refused too; the form shows the currency locked with the reason

situation: A currency that is not one
given: any Staff Member who may configure
when: they save a code that is not three capital letters
then: refused by a check constraint

given: a Property in Europe/Istanbul
then: the timezone changes and app.property_today() answers in Dubai's clock from the next statement

situation: A timezone Postgres does not know
given: any Staff Member who may configure
then: refused by the existing check constraint app.is_valid_timezone(), never by a cast error inside a later date query

given: a Property with a 04:00 cutoff
then: the cutoff changes; between 04:00 and 06:00 the Property is still working the day before

given: any Staff Member who may configure
then: refused by the existing check constraint (ADR 0021), because a cutoff before 03:00 can be crossed twice on a clock change

given: a form with a changed timezone or cutoff
then: it states the business date now and the one the change would make, computed by the same rule as app.business_date(); when they differ it says so in words

given: ranza_app holding the update grant on properties
when: an update names organization_id or status
then: refused by the column grant: this feature changes four settings and nothing about who owns the Property or whether it trades

given: a Staff Member without configuration.manage
then: refused by the update policy

given: a Staff Member with reach to one Property only
when: they save settings for another Property in the same Organization
then: the update matches no row and the module reports a refusal

given: a Staff Member of one Organization
when: they save settings for another Organization's Property
then: the update matches no row and the module reports a refusal

given: an Organization whose Subscription is not active
when: a Staff Member with the permission saves a Property setting
then: refused by the policy's commercial gates, and the page shows the not-entitled state

given: two Staff Members open the same Property's settings
then: the second save names the version it was read at, matches no row, and is told the settings changed; the form shows what is saved now and keeps nothing silently

given: any saved Property setting
then: one audit record property.configured names who, where, and each changed setting from and to; a save that changes nothing records nothing

given: any saved Property setting
then: updated_at is stamped by the database rather than named by the caller

given: the permission catalogue after this migration
then: Owner and Manager hold configuration.manage; Front desk, Finance and Housekeeping do not, and an Organization may compose it into any role (ADR 0026)

situation: A Folio opened while the currency changes
given: a Property with no Folio yet
when: a check-in opens its first Folio while another Staff Member saves a new currency
then: the two serialise on the Property row: whichever commits second is refused, so no Folio is ever committed in a currency its Property no longer trades in (ADR 0015). A losing currency change is told the currency is fixed; a losing check-in fails with the generic error and succeeds when retried

situation: A change that reopens a closed day
given: a Property whose business day has been closed
when: a Staff Member saves a timezone or cutoff that would date today on or before it
then: refused by close the day's guard with RZ001, and shown as that refusal in the reader's language, keeping the draft, with focus on the time zone when only it changed and on the cutoff otherwise; a name change alone still saves

situation: A save and a check-in at once
given: a check-in holding the Property's advisory lock shared
then: the save takes the Property's advisory lock before touching the row, so the two lock in one order and never deadlock; the id is hashed in its canonical form, as the guard hashes it. The lock is taken through a read of the Property row, so somebody who cannot see the Property locks nothing and is refused at once rather than holding up its check-ins

situation: An unknown zone beside close the day
given: close the day's guard on properties
when: a timezone Postgres does not know is saved
then: the guard steps aside for a zone Postgres does not know, so properties_timezone_check refuses it as CF-S1-07 says, rather than an error from inside the guard (20260916006100)

given: a Staff Member holding configuration.manage with Organization-wide reach
then: the name changes everywhere it is shown, and one audit record organization.configured names from and to

given: a Staff Member holding configuration.manage with reach to some Properties only
then: refused by the policy: the name governs Properties they cannot reach, as the housekeeping default does (HK-S3-05)

given: ranza_app holding the update grant on organizations
when: an update names status or default_locale
then: refused by the column grant

situation: An Organization name that says nothing
given: a Staff Member who may rename it
when: they save an empty or over-long name
then: refused by the existing check constraint (two to 120 trimmed characters)

given: two Staff Members with the form open
then: the second is refused as stale and shown the saved name

given: a Staff Member reaching the Property without configuration.manage
then: every value is shown and every control is disabled, with one line saying who can change it; nothing is hidden, because the values are what their screens obey

given: a Staff Member with the permission and reach to one Property
then: the Property cards are editable and the Organization card is read-only with the reason

given: a viewer whose Organization is not entitled to configuration or who reaches no Property that has it
then: the existing not-entitled empty state

given: a card whose values are what was loaded
then: Save and Discard are disabled; changing a value enables both, Discard restores what was loaded, and saving shows Saved inline without leaving the page

given: any refused save
then: the form keeps what was typed, says why in the reader's language, and focuses the first field at fault

given: a Property where housekeeping is available
then: the inspection setting is shown by the same component and saved by the same command as on the Housekeeping screen, so the two can never disagree

given: a Property where housekeeping is not available
then: the housekeeping section is absent rather than empty

given: a Property
then: it lists the capabilities enabled at this Property by name, read-only; nothing the Organization has not bought is shown, never as an upsell (blueprint 4.6)

given: any viewer
when: the page is read on a wide screen
then: a section list beside the cards jumps to each and marks the one in view; on a narrow screen it becomes a row of chips above them

given: the page in Turkish, English and Arabic
then: every label is translated, Arabic mirrors by logical properties, and the timezone and currency are named in the reader's language

given: the screen registry
then: Configuration is marked built and its planned-screen text is gone

given: a Property where maintenance is available
then: how maintenance works there is shown by the Maintenance screen's own component and saved by its own command, and the section is absent where maintenance is not available

situation: A setting saved here stays saved here
given: the inspection or maintenance setting changed from Configuration
then: the control shows what was saved rather than snapping back to the old answer. What binds is that the save revalidates any path: a server action that revalidates refreshes the page it was called from, so Configuration needs no path of its own. Seen red only when the save revalidated nothing at all

given: organizations.default_locale exists and nothing reads it
then: deferred: a control that changes nothing is not shown; it arrives with the first thing that uses it, the Portal's language for a Resident with no preference

given: a Property with an Entitlement for a module
when: an Organization would switch a capability off
then: deferred: what happens to in-house Stays and open Folios when the front desk is switched off is a workflow of its own

given: blueprint 2's Feature Configuration at department or outlet scope
when: a value would differ by department
then: deferred until a workflow needs a value that is not already a column

given: an Organization opening a second hotel
then: deferred: a new Property needs capabilities, assignments and a trial of its own, and is provisioning rather than configuration

situation: A closed day and a moved clock
given: a Property whose business day has been closed (RANZ-26)
when: its timezone or cutoff is changed so today moves back into a closed day
then: resolved: close the day (RANZ-26) merged, and its guard on properties takes the Property's advisory lock and raises RZ001. configureProperty maps RZ001 to a refusal on the cutoff field (CF-S1-21) and takes that lock first (CF-S1-22)
